tools.name: list_pricing
tools.description: List credit prices. 1 credit = $0.01. Top up with get_payment_info + claim_payment (USDC on Base) or x402.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Return remaining credits, plan, and spend.

tools.name: get_payment_info
tools.description: USDC-on-Base receiving address, packs, and x402 instructions. Receive-only: this server never holds a private key.

tools.name: claim_payment
tools.description: Credit this API key after a USDC Transfer on Base to PAYMENT_ADDRESS. tx hash is unique.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Lock a USD→μNOID quote for ~30 minutes. Requires NOID_USD_RATE or PRICE_FEED_URL (not explorer premium).

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create a checkout invoice. Payer sends NOID to the MERCHANT o1 address. This server never holds funds or secrets.

tools.name: check_invoice
tools.description: Refresh an invoice against the public permanode API and return confirmation status.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices created by this API key.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a pasted Parano1d payment receipt hex or txid against explorer data (and optional local RPC paranoid_verifyReceipt).

tools.name: get_whale_moves
tools.description: Rich-list balance changes over a μNOID threshold vs the cached snapshot.

tools.name: get_new_tokens
tools.description: Newest native assets/listings from the public explorer native API.

tools.name: get_mempool_highlights
tools.description: Pending mempool size, fee floor, and a short highlight list.

tools.name: get_hashrate_shift
tools.description: Network hashrate versus the previous cached sample.

tools.name: upsert_watchlist
tools.description: Create or update a watchlist. Optional https webhook is HMAC-signed on change.

tools.name: list_watchlists
tools.description: List watchlists for this API key.

tools.name: create_launch_kit
tools.description: Native NOID asset launch checklist from public protocol docs. Optionally calls Launchkit MCP generate tools when CREATIVE_MCP_* env vars are set. Never submits on-chain.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_payment_info" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
